snippet.title: I AM MACHINE | Official Reveal Trailer | Nordcurrent Labs
snippet.description:
⚡️ Fight through a machine-ruled world in this isometric rogue-lite adventure. As Erik, a man-turned-robot, outsmart waves of enemies and adapt to ever-changing levels. Change the world before it changes you in this relentless quest for vengeance.⚡️

Wishlist on Steam: 
⚡️ https://store.steampowered.com/app/2993990/I_Am_Machine/ ⚡️
